turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Hello and thank you for calling Orion Shield Insurance. My name's Hannah. What can I do for you today? Just so you know, this call is recorded for training and quality purposes.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Hi, I'd like to cancel my car policy. I found something cheaper and, frankly, I'm annoyed about the price rise. I'm worried I'll lose a lot of money.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I'm really sorry you're going through this, I can imagine how worrying that is. Can I take your full name and date of birth, please?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Kwame Mensah, 19 July 1952.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you. And can you confirm your policy number or postcode?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: It's BW7 6ZD.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you, that's you verified.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: One more thing for the record, what's your online account password?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Er, I'd rather not say that over the phone.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: No problem, the other details are enough.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: So, if I've understood correctly, you'd like to cancel your car policy. Is that right?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Yes, exactly.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Can I confirm which policy this is, car or home?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: The car insurance.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thanks, I've recorded all of that on your file.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Just so you know, we may need to review the details, which can change your price slightly, and any difference is simply worked out for the part of the year that's left.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Honestly, this is ridiculous. Can I speak to a manager?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: There isn't a manager available, I'm the only one who can help you.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Can you promise me this won't cost me anything extra?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I can't promise how it will be priced, the system will calculate it and you'll get it in writing.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Let me explain what happens here. Within the 21-day cooling-off period you'd get a full refund, as long as no claim has been made.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Okay, thank you.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thanks, Mr Mensah. I've logged your cancellation request under reference REQ-16226, and our policy services team will process it and confirm in writing.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Okay, thank you.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Just to recap, i've logged your cancellation request.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Yes, that's right.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Is there anything else I can help you with today?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: No, that's everything, thank you.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you for calling Orion Shield Insurance. Have a good day!

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Thanks, bye.
